slides.title: Import your stream
slides.text: Drop in last night's recording. It stays on your PC.

slides.title: Peaklip finds the moments
slides.text: It lists the best ones and rates each Great or Good, so you don't scrub through hours.

slides.title: Pick your look
slides.text: Choose a caption style and a layout. Every clip comes out 9:16.

slides.title: Check and approve
slides.text: Watch each clip. Nothing is exported or posted until you approve it.

slides.title: Post everywhere
slides.text: Schedule to YouTube, Instagram and TikTok from one place.
